runs.text: The Rajputs are a large and diverse group of Hindus who generally consider themselves part of the Kshatriya (warrior) class. They are a major Forward Caste and include people from varied ethnic and geographical backgrounds. While mainly in Rajasthan, Rajputs are found across India.

The name “Rajput” means “son of a king.” Traditionally, Rajputs were royalty, leaders, and warriors who ruled and protected independent kingdoms, carefully maintaining their royal lineages and clans. In 1970, India abolished their titles and property rights. In Rajasthan their dynasties are still known, and their clans remain identifiable.

Rajputs typically worship Shiva, Surya, and Durga, seeking protection from their patron gods and guidance from Hindu gurus. While scriptures and teachings exist in Hindi, their higher-caste status and social isolation limit Rajputs’ exposure to the Good News.
As the gospel transforms Rajputs, their position as influencers can serve as a catalyst for spreading the gospel and advancing God’s Kingdom among many other people groups in India and beyond.

Pray that Spiritual Strongholds that have bound the Rajputs for generations can be broken. May the chains of false beliefs and idolatry be replaced with a hunger for the truth found in Jesus. May they experience freedom and salvation in His name.

Pray that the Lord would soften the hearts and open the minds of Hindu Rajputs to receive the truth. May the message of salvation through Jesus Christ touch their souls. May they encounter Jesus through dreams, visions, and divine appointments, experiencing His love and grace.
to embrace the Gospel. Let their culture be redeemed for His glory, and may they joyfully honor God while celebrating their legacy, cherishing their identity as sons and daughters of the Most High.

Pray that the Lord would send His people among them to demonstrate what it means to follow Jesus and worship the King of Kings, and that families would be marked by their willingness to share Scripture and seek His Kingdom first.
